b.title_zh: 第五圈·愤怒（与忧郁沉抑者）
b.text_zh: 《地狱篇》第5圈，Inf. VII-VIII。罪：暴怒者（iracondi）在水面，忧郁沉抑者（accidiosi / tristi）在泥下。刑（contrapasso）：暴怒者在斯提克斯沼的水面上互相撕咬；沉抑者陷在泥下，含着泥浆咕哝，永远说不成一句完整的话。守卫：Phlegyas。
b.text_en: The fifth circle of Dante's Hell, Inf. VII-VIII. The wrathful (iracondi) on the surface, and the sullen (accidiosi / tristi) beneath it. b.title_zh: 第九圈·背叛（科奇土斯冰湖 Cocytus，四带）
b.text_zh: 《地狱篇》第9圈，Inf. XXXI-XXXIV。罪：背叛者，按背叛的信任关系分作四带：血亲、国家、宾主、恩主。刑（contrapasso）：冻在科奇土斯冰湖中，各带的姿势不同。守卫：the Giants at the rim; Antaeus lowers the travellers in。
b.text_en: The ninth circle of Dante's Hell, Inf. XXXI-XXXIV. Traitors, divided by the bond betrayed: kin, country, guest, benefactor. Frozen into the lake of Cocytus, each zone held in a different posture. Guarded by the Giants at the rim; Antaeus lowers the travellers in.

payload_json.conjecture: Virgil's speech puts treachery under fraud: fraud practised on one who trusts breaks the special bond, and 'hence in the smallest circle ... whoe'er betrays for ever is consumed' (Inf. XI.52-66, Longfellow). The heading carried is therefore malizia — frode, of the kind that betrays a trust. Until 2026-11-13 this article carried 「matta bestialitade」, a reading taken from verify-christian-structure.md §2. Which circle that third word names is disputed among the commentators (violence is the usual reading) and this corpus assigns it to none; it is marked here so that nobody re-derives either as settled.

b.title_zh: 第九圈第四带·犹大带（背叛恩主）
b.text_zh: 《地狱篇》第9圈第4带（Giudecca），Inf. XXXIV。罪：背叛恩主者；Judas、Brutus、Cassius 在撒旦的三张嘴中。刑（contrapasso）：完全埋在冰下，姿态各异，无一能出声；三名首恶被撒旦的三张嘴永远咀嚼。守卫：Lucifer。
b.text_en: Giudecca, the fourth zone of Cocytus of the ninth circle, Inf. XXXIV. Those who betrayed a benefactor; Judas, Brutus and Cassius are in Lucifer's three mouths. Wholly buried under the ice in every posture and wholly silent; the three chief traitors are chewed forever in Lucifer's three mouths. Guarded by Lucifer.

Gregory's seven have tristitia and no acedia (Moralia in Job XXXI.xlv.87); acedia is the name the later Western list uses and the one that fits Dante's fourth terrace.

/judgment/statutes/#6127f852-d978-4dd7-b.text_zh: 《地狱篇》第1圈，Inf. IV。罪：未受洗的婴儿；无罪而未受洗的有德异教徒（荷马、亚里士多德）；以及但丁破例安置于此的几位基督之后的非基督徒（萨拉丁 IV.129、阿维森纳 IV.143、阿威罗伊 IV.144）。刑（contrapasso）：没有肉体刑罚。此处唯一的苦是无望而仍有欲（Inf. IV.42「我们无望地活在渴望中」）。
/judgment/statutes/#6127f852-d978-4dd7-b.text_en: The first circle of Dante's Hell, Inf. IV. The unbaptized infants; the virtuous pagans who lived before Christ — Homer, Aristotle; and the non-Christians of Dante's own era whom he places here by exception — Saladin (IV.129, d. 1193), Avicenna (IV.143, d. 1037), Averroes (IV.144, d. 1198). payload_json.conjecture: Virgil's speech puts treachery under fraud: fraud practised on one who trusts breaks the special bond, and 'hence in the smallest circle ... whoe'er betrays for ever is consumed' (Inf. XI.52-66, Longfellow). The heading carried is therefore malizia — frode, of the kind that betrays a trust. Until 2026-11-13 this article carried 「matta bestialitade」, a reading taken from verify-christian-structure.md §2. Which circle that third word names is disputed among the commentators (violence is the usual reading) and this corpus assigns it to none; it is marked here so that nobody re-derives either as settled.

payload_json.contrapasso_zh: 完全埋在冰下，姿态各异，无一能出声；三名首恶被撒旦的三张嘴永远咀嚼。
